rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §13's stated root cause matches its cited evidence (the §12 review logged the in-flight launch window) and both mechanism-to-measure chains hold, but the reservation is placed at the pointer write in `reckon/crew/dispatch.py`, which is after `_create_worktree` in the same function, so the window §13 exists to close still rebuilds the in-flight launch's worktree before the refusal fires.
